profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Yellow Duck Technologies
profile.summary: I have 25 years of experience as a full stack software engineer.  I have used a variety of tools, including web servers such as Tomcat, Wildly, and Nginx.  Front end libraries/frameworks that I have used in the past include VueJs, ReactJs, and ExtJs. Javascript, HTML, JSON, and CSS are tools that I have used to assist with the building out of front end applications.  Express, Jersey, and Spring Boot are tools that I have used to build out APIs.  Java, NodeJs, and Ruby on Rails have been utilized to create server side code.  MongoDb, Oracle, MySql Server, and Postgres are databases that have been utilized for the storage of data.  The Agile/Scrum methodology, JIRA, and Confluence have been used to assist with ticket management and communication amongst my team.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: This role allowed me to dive deeper into User Interface development while utilizing the  VueJs framework to create a multitude of applications.  While in this role, I was able to successfully upgrade multiple applications running on the Vue 2.5 framework, to Vue 3.0.  The Vuetify library was also used to assist with building front end components.  REST calls were made to back-end SpringBoot endpoints utilizing the  Axios library. Git CI/CD was utilized to ensure builds and pipelines completed successfully.  Docker is utilized to containerize the build and Kubernetes is utilized in the deployment of those containers.
positions.insights: Skills: CentOS · Kubernetes · Web Components · JavaScript · docker · VueJs · Bash · Java Development · axios · Spring Boot · Gitlab · Swagger API · Debugging · Agile Software Development · Linux · Programming · REST APIs · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: This role allowed me to develop enterprise applications for my client.  While in this role, I was able to strengthen my familiarity with VueJs as a front end framework and gained valuable experience utilizing TypeScript in the applications that were delivered.  My time on this project also introduced me to utilizing NodeJs as a back end, Nginx as a Web Server, and building Niagara Files (NiFi) components and routes to assist with moving data between applications.
positions.insights: Skills: CentOS · Node.js · TypeScript · Web Components · VueJs · Nginx · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · axios · Jenkins · Apache NiFi · Swagger API · Debugging · Agile Software Development · API Development · Express.js · MongoDB · Programming · REST APIs

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Annapolis Junction, Maryland, United States · On-site
positions.description: My responsibility in this role allows me to develop enterprise Java applications for my client.  This role has provided me with the opportunity to familiarize myself with VueJS, PrimeFaces, MongoDB, Wildfly, XHTML, and SpringBoot.  In addition to these tools, I have been able to enhance my expertise with Java, JUnit, Jira, and REST during my time in this role.
positions.insights: Skills: WildFly · Vuetify · Mockito · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Web Components · Vue.js · J Unit · Java Development · XHTML · Jira · Spring Boot · Debugging · Agile Software Development · JUnit · API Development · Primefaces · MongoDB · Programming · REST APIs

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer
positions.description: My responsibility in this role allows me to work on a variety of products in order to build and deploy applications for my client that are deployed around the world.  This role has provided me with the opportunity to familiarize myself with Ruby on Rails, ReactJS, Machine Shop, MySQL, and the Grape REST API. During the development of these applications, I have ensured stability of the products by creating automated tests utilizing Cucumber and Selenium as test automation tool suites.
positions.insights: Skills: CentOS · Grape API · Model-View-Controller (MVC) · Web Components · docker · MySQL · Selenium · Ruby on Rails · Debugging · Agile Software Development · API Development · Cucumber · Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · Programming · React.js

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description: My responsibility in this role requires me to develop enterprise Java applications for my client.  This role gives me the opportunity to utilize Java and JavaScript toolsets to create rich applications that provide real time data for users. In order to accomplish my task, I utilize the Ext JS java-script framework to create rich graphical user interfaces.  AJAX, DWR, Dozer, and JSON are tools used which enable data to be passed between the front end GUI and backend application.  In addition to this, hibernate is used to transfer data between the backend application classes and the Oracle database. This role also required me to implement Apache Camel to route JMS messages to their appropriate classes as well as Restful Web Services which are used to pass information between various systems.  Other tools that have been utilized to assist in accomplishing my tasks are ExtJS, Java EE, JIRA, JUnit, Maven, Mockito, Spring, and Tomcat.
positions.insights: Skills: ActiveMQ · Mockito · JSON · Web Components · JavaScript · AJAX · Ext JS · J Unit · Java Development · Spring MVC · Hibernate · Jira · Dozer · J2EE Application Development · Debugging · Agile Software Development · Tomcat · Maven · Apache Camel · Oracle · Programming

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.locationName: Annapolis Junction, Maryland, United States · On-site
positions.description: My responsibility in this role requires me to lead small develop teams to ensure that web based applications are delivered with quality to my clients.  This role has given me the opportunity to participate in drafting proposals and deploying web based applications to my users.  I have developed and delivered Siebel applications utilizing its public sector, field service, and eService modules.  In addition to this, I have utilized the ASP.Net framework in order to facilitate the creation of websites, Cross Domain Solutions, and web services for my clients.  I have also been able to utilize the combination of ExtJs and Java to create robust Java Script front-end and Java backend web applications for my users. ASP, BiPublisher, C#, ExtJs, HTML, Java, JavaScript, Jenkins, jQuery, JSON, Maven, OBIEE, OSES, PostGress, Siebel Tools, Siebel Personalization, Siebel EAi, eScript, Siebel Workflow, VmWare, and XML are tools that were utilized in order to assist me in achieving my tasks.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · jQuery · C# · JSON · Web Components · JavaScript · Ext JS · OBIEE · Java Development · HTML · Jenkins · VMware · Oracle Siebel CRM · Debugging · Agile Software Development · Java · Maven · PostgreSQL · Programming

positions.title: Software Development Lead
positions.description: My responsibility in this role required me to act as the SAP BI reporting team lead.  While in this role I gathered detailed business reporting requirements, created technical specification documents, performed configuration, coordinated user acceptance testing, and coordinated training and rollout plans.  In addition to these tasks I also provided technical direction to team members, and interfaced with clients to ensure that their requirements were implemented correctly and in a timely fashion.  The SAP BW, SAP GUI, and SAP Query Designer tools were used to help facilitate me in meeting my responsibilities.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · JavaScript · Writing · Java · Oracle · SAP · Programming

positions.title: Siebel Certified Consultant
positions.description: My responsibility in this role entailed designing, developing, enhancing, debugging, and maintaining a Siebel Call Center Application.  Siebel Tools, eMail Response, eScript, JavaScript, Web Services, Business Services, and Workflow were tools that were used in order to achieve this.  In addition to these tasks, I also had the responsibility of communicating with various departments in order to gather and translate requirements into a system design that could be implemented

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: My responsibility in this role entailed configuring and maintaining Siebel Field Service Applications.  In order to achieve this I provided support in the areas of Siebel Tools Configuration, Workflow, EAI, and e-Script.  In addition to these tasks, I also served as the Actuate Report team-lead.  While in the position, I was responsible for the release of three successful Siebel implementations.  These releases include an upgrade from Siebel 7.0.4 to Siebel 7.5.3 and a release based on the Siebel 7.7 environment

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: My responsibility to this organization entailed creating a back-end management tool utilizing the Microsoft Visual Studio toolset.  The tool allowed various groups within the organization to track and manage their resources as well as view pertinent information about those resources in detailed reports.  In addition to this task, I was responsible for the configuration and deployment of Siebel Call Center applications to federal government agencies nationwide.  Tools used while in this role were ASP, JavaScript, Visual Basic, C#, Crystal Reports, Siebel Tools, Siebel Assignment Manager, Siebel EAI, Siebel VB and Siebel Anywhere.
